comment: The clocks at which the senses' schedule observations are derived from RFC 5545's own examples (generators/senses, sensescases, writes app/specs/senses/observed/spec.json). 'base' is the person's IRI in the requests. Each clock is an RFC 3339 instant in UTC: the first falls inside the conference of RFC 5545 section 4's second example, the second in the hour before the party of section 3.4's example.
